## Acceptance and qualification gates
- [ ] G0: Specification and owner/interface contract frozen
- [ ] G1: Implementation tests and observables verified
- [ ] G2: Negative controls / adversarial checks where relevant
- [ ] G3: Reproducible evidence and independent verification where required
- [ ] G4: Integration and merged-code verification

Write PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_RUN / BLOCKED, with source commit and evidence links, for **each** gate.
